methodology.approval: No runtime-approved or installed templates in this research inventory.
methodology.review_first: Priority for inspecting/converting, not proof of current compatibility.
methodology.automatic_flags: Keyword flags can be false positives, including negated descriptions. Use explicit review notes.
methodology.counts: Records are sources/versions, not unique approved floorplans. Known lineages are grouped; further geometric deduplication is required.
methodology.rights: Downloaded saves remain local; licensing and attribution must be checked before redistribution.
methodology.payloads: Format signature, content hash and local bytes verified; not yet imported into Fortify or Rust.
